objective: Preallocate EXPLAIN fallback data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate EXPLAIN data prefixes
tasks.result: EXPLAIN join-order fallback row counting now uses an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in EXPLAIN comma-join row-count fallback construction.
Added a SQL DDL regression that exercises EXPLAIN join-order row counting without ANALYZE statistics.
Generated prefix bytes, count_prefix inputs, fallback row estimates, join-order text, and SQL DDL behavior are unchanged.
